title: The Grunion Run, 2009 · before
logline: Four days after 'Lanes': Wood on the beach the day before the twelfth run, looking not at the water but back at the town, at the ridge, in daylight, where there's nothing. Gully setting lantern posts. Gully asks what he's looking at. Nothing, Wood says. Gully looks too.

panels.composition: The beach by day. GULLY driving lantern posts into the sand. WOOD with his back to the water, looking at the ridge behind the town. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man driving wooden posts into beach sand while a thin man stands with his back to the water looking toward a wooded ridge beyond a town

panels.composition: The ridge in daylight: trees, the cut, nothing over it.

brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man straightening up from driving a post to ask a question

panels.composition: WOOD. And GULLY looking too, now.
